feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 31 August 2026 3:58pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 31 August 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north and northeast of Scotland. High pressure to the west of Portugal with a ridge to sea area Malin, slowly transferring eastwards.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, imminently backing West 3 or 4, then Southwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then showers spreading into the north of the area later tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in places later tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, perhaps occasionally 6 in places, soon backing South 3 or 4 for a while, then becoming South or Southwest 4 or 5 on Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Showers, then rain overnight into Wednesday morning, clearing to isolated showers in the the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in precipitation.
